snippet.title: Amiga Longplay Savage
snippet.description:
http://www.recordedamigagames.org

Played by Ironclaw

Only practised a couple of times on each stage before recording. So I'm not playing very efficiently :).

The game didn't have much of an intro, so didn't include it. Will upload the "intro" later as a Misc movie. -
